note: The owner paused desktop updates on 2026-10-11, until further notice. While "desktop" is "paused", the Publish Orbit update Action signs new pages into web-update.json only (the web version, app.fafoaco.com) and leaves update.json, which installed apps read, on the release it has. Set "desktop" to "follow" to let installed apps follow releases again: the next run brings them up to the newest page.
